mapper.sql: select profile_id, account_id, baby_name, age_range, parent_goal, starter_scene_id, starter_moment_id, starter_activity_id, starter_utterance_id, starter_phrase_id, starter_source, onboarding_state, onboarding_completed_at, version, created_at, updated_at from baby_profiles
mapper.select: select bp.profile_id, bp.account_id, bp.baby_name, bp.age_range, bp.parent_goal, bp.starter_scene_id, bp.starter_moment_id, bp.starter_activity_id, bp.starter_utterance_id, bp.starter_phrase_id, bp.starter_source, bp.onboarding_state, bp.onboarding_completed_at, bp.version, bp.created_at, bp.updated_at from baby_profiles bp join households h on h.owner_account_id = bp.account_id and h.status = 'active' join household_members requester on requester.household_id = h.household_id and requester.account_id = #{accountId} and requester.role = 'caregiver' and requester.status = 'active' join household_members owner_member on owner_member.household_id = h.household_id and owner_member.account_id = h.owner_account_id and owner_member.role = 'primary_caregiver' and owner_member.status = 'active'
mapper.update: update baby_profiles set baby_name = #{patch.babyName}, age_range = #{patch.ageRange}, parent_goal = #{patch.parentGoal}, starter_scene_id = #{patch.starterSceneId}, starter_moment_id = #{patch.starterMomentId}, starter_activity_id = #{patch.starterActivityId}, starter_utterance_id = #{patch.starterUtteranceId}, starter_phrase_id = #{patch.starterPhraseId}, starter_source = #{patch.starterSource}, onboarding_state = #{patch.onboardingState}, onboarding_completed_at = #{patch.onboardingCompletedAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, version = version + 1 where account_id = #{accountId} and version = #{expectedVersion}
